XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: First speed of passenger compartment air conditioning fans inactive
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: CLIMATE | AIR CONDITIONING | RESISTANCE | HEATING | AIR | FAN | FAN | TURNS | BLOCKED | ON | HOT | COLD | SPEED | WORKS | OPERATION | FAILED | AIR CONDITIONING | CLIMATE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars equipped with manual air conditioning

  • System: Air conditioning

  • Device: Cabin fan resistor

  • Fault: When setting the cabin ventilation to the first speed, the fans are inactive, while at the other speeds set, the system works correctly

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Defective cabin fan resistor.

• Action: Check that the cabin fan resistor is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located on the passenger side, in the passenger compartment, on the left under the glove compartment towards the centre tunnel behind a plastic cover. The faulty resistor did not show any visible abnormalities.
